author: Competition team
review_scope: Newest accessible India-English reviews. Preserve source pagination and all ratings. Stop at cutoff start or bounded retrieval cap, report truncation.
sample_rationale: Purposive tier-balanced 12-edition sample across regions and early/mid/late completed season. Selected before new schedule extraction. Not population-representative. Record failures without silent substitution.
calendar_scope: 2026 event-level universe, verified sampled sessions, next-event published windows. Separate qualifying/main draw, ATP/WTA, scheduled/not-before/actual, and programme revision.
price_scope: India public logged-out observed offers. No purchases or account access. Preserve list/promo/renewal and entitlement uncertainty.
search_interest_scope: India 2026-01-01 through 2026-09-12. Common query window and anchors. No inferred WTP or subscriber counts.
raw_definition: Original fetched body or documented browser-visible capture. Parsing/normalization excluded from raw provider files. Failed requests retained separately.

protocol_amendments.change: Extended mobile retrieval from 10000 to a maximum 30000 using preserved public continuation token, to reach the original January 2025 boundary. No review content outcome used to choose stopping point.
Product snapshots retain actual retrieval date, not the historical review cutoff. Current-source information must not be treated as available at past advertising decisions.

raw-v2 retries retain all v1 bodies and archive its metadata. Recovered missing official draw/order PDFs, secondary 2025/2026 results files and a complete browser-visible four-term Trends daily table. Broader five-term 2025-2026 endpoint returned 429 and was not retried. Preserve route-specific monthly offers. Ongoing US Open results fetched after the study cutoff require independent match dates before cutoff filtering.

Raw-v4 recovers 2025 two-term weekly Trends after a five-term request failed, plus two-season La Liga data, official MotoGP 2026 session APIs and linked sprint/race PDFs. Keep original 2026 research cutoff, future schedules, response dates and actual/planned times separate. Broader data collection does not make original ATP sample representative.

raw_v5_closure.additional_sources: 7 HTTP sources plus full football table and two selected browser offer observations
raw_v5_closure.search_normalization: Football/FanCode is a separate 255-day request. Do not treat all series as one common-scale request.
raw_v5_closure.collection_closure: All failed HTTP IDs mapped to evidence replacements or explicit scenario/exclusion treatments. Private facts remain unknown.
